description:
HomePulse: Global home intelligence API. AI-synthesized home maintenance checklists, improvement ROI analysis, neighborhood research, smart home integration, energy efficiency guidance, contractor task briefings

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • value ($0.10): Home value estimate
  • neighborhood ($0.10): Neighborhood analysis
  • improve ($0.10): Home improvement ROI analysis
  • maintain ($0.08): Seasonal maintenance checklist
  • rent ($0.08): Rental market analysis
  • contractor ($0.10): Contractor vetting guide
  • energy ($0.10): Home energy efficiency
  • maintenance ($0.08): Personalized home maintenance calendar
  • roi ($0.10): Home improvement resale ROI
  • smart ($0.08): Smart home ecosystem advisor

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: value | neighborhood | improve | maintain | rent | contractor | energy | maintenance | roi | smart

country.description: Country (e.g. US, UK, CA, DE, AU) — selects local currency and property portals

county.description: County name hint for HUD FMR matching (US only)

home_value.description: Current estimated home value, in local currency

location.description: Postal code or city (e.g. 90210, M5V 2T6, SW1A)

region.description: Region or state/province (e.g. Northeast, Pacific Northwest, Bavaria, New South Wales)

season.description: Defaults to current season (hemisphere-corrected when country is given)

sqft.description: Square footage (or square meters — state units)

name: homepulse
